title: Ch’amakan Yatiñan Arupawa
intro: Nayra pachan mä jaqi, wali amuyt’ir jaqimp uñt’atawa, patak patak maranakaw jumamp parlt’i. Uka jaqejj janipuniw profetätwa sasin siskänti, ukampis Diosan yatiñapajj arunakapatwa jalluntäna. Mä awk taykax mä wiñay herencia jaytawayi, jupanakan iwxt’awinakapax millones de jaqinakan chuymapanx imatäskiwa, jichhürkamaw arsusipxi ukat lup’ipxi.
clues: Mä divin regalo katuqta, ukax yaqhachawayitu - mä yatiñax wali manqhankiwa, ukax historianx nayan definidor rasgojaruw tukuwayi.
Nayax janiw mä yatiyirikïkti ni mä angeläkti - mä almakiwa, akapachan wali amuyt’añampi ukat amuyt’añampi bendicita.
Nayan wali sum apasiñajajj wawajampiw utjäna, ukat uka lazompiw jukʼamp wiñay yatiyäwijajj yatiyasïna.
Taqi kun churitu ukar yuspärañatakiw achikt’asiyäta, ukat jach’a jach’a tukuñat jach’a jach’a tukuñat iwxt’arakta.
Mä mostaza jathat sipansa jukʼamp chʼamanïñsa, altʼat chuymanïsajj arup jiskʼachañajj kunja wakiskirisa uka toqetwa yatichayäta.
Quran qillqatan mä jaljaw sutix apt’ata, ukanx munat wawajar iwxt’atajax wiñayatakiw imatäski.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
